svg.title: Expected yield at equal weighted contact capacity
svg.desc: Screening rules share the same expected weighted coverage. At 50% coverage, the five-state and digital rules yield 24.59 and 24.19 cases per 100 expected weighted contacts. The lower panel compares the five-state rule with digital, integrated and retrospectively selected best binary rules. Line patterns and markers distinguish those comparisons.
